title: Modbus TCP MBAP Header Parsing & Construction
description:
Modbus TCP is the global industrial automation standard protocol across PLCs, SCADA, and IoT gateways.

### MBAP Header Specification:
- Bytes [0..1]: Transaction ID (16-bit BE)
- Bytes [2..3]: Protocol ID (16-bit BE, must be 0 for Modbus)
- Bytes [4..5]: Length (16-bit BE: 1 unit_id byte + PDU length)
- Byte 6: Unit ID

### Requirements:
Implement `parse_modbus_tcp_header` and `build_modbus_tcp_header`.
hint: Validate that `frame_len >= 7` and `protocol_id == 0` before accepting the frame.
